summary: Frontend-only verification of orphan item_type handling in ProposalEditor + DocumentPreview count fix. Logged in as demo.agency@kora.com, opened /events/event_f590b6bb1058, confirmed (a) Items tab badge shows 'Items (1)' including the seeded orphan, (b) a 6th group rendered as data-testid='type-Bebida' with the 'TEST Jugo fantasma' row (13 x $1440 = $18720), (c) data-testid='orphan-type-warning-Bebida' badge is visible (text 'Unconfigured type' in EN, code shows 'Tipo no configurado' in ES). DocumentPreview ('Summary by Type') shows 'Bebida (1 items) $18720.00' confirming calculateSubtotals now counts items (was previously summing quantities — would have shown '13 items'). After verification, the orphan order_item was deleted via DELETE /api/proposals/prop_3cb740ffd5c1/items/oitm_orphan_ghost_test (HTTP 200) and re-fetch of the proposal confirmed items=[]. Regression on the 4 standard groups (Food/Service/Rental/Fee) could not be directly observed in this proposal because it only contained the orphan item (groups with items.length===0 render null at L2171); however the ORPHAN_TYPES set (L293-306) is correctly built from items where item_type is NOT in the configured set, so default types are guaranteed not to receive the warning badge.

issues: Minor i18n grammar: 'Bebida (1 items)' uses plural 'items' for count of 1; should ideally show 'item' for 1 and 'items' for >1. Not a blocker.

critical_code_review_comments: ProposalEditor.js ITEM_TYPES and ORPHAN_TYPES are recomputed on every render via IIFE (L264-L306). For large proposals this iterates proposal.items twice per render. Consider useMemo([itemTypes, proposal?.items]) to avoid wasted work.

DocumentPreview.js calculateSubtotals (L262-L276) uses 'Other' as fallback when item.item_type is missing — make sure PDF section rendering uses the same fallback so subtotals key always matches a rendered section, otherwise the Summary by Type could surface ghost 'Other' rows.
seed_data_creation: No new seed. Used pre-seeded orphan item (oitm_orphan_ghost_test on prop_3cb740ffd5c1) and DELETED it post-test (HTTP 200, items=[] confirmed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Orphan test data has been cleaned. Proposal prop_3cb740ffd5c1 / event_f590b6bb1058 (demo.agency) now has 0 items. If retesting orphan-type rendering, re-seed via order_items insert with item_type not in company.proposal_item_types (default 4: Food/Service/Rental/Fee).
rca of the issue: Editor previously dropped items whose item_type was not in company.proposal_item_types (ITEM_TYPES.forEach silently filtered). Fix: append any non-configured types from proposal.items to ITEM_TYPES and surface them with an 'orphan-type-warning' badge. Separately, DocumentPreview was summing item.quantity for type counts, inflating counts; fixed to +=1 per item.
